notes.title: Update 1.07 – Singleplayer Mode & Level 1 Enhancements!
notes.content:
After a few months of inactivity, we're back with an exciting update! Players can now enjoy the game offline in single-player mode, in addition to the existing multiplayer. We've also enhanced the first level by adding new NPCs and functionalities.

Our main focus is now on Level 2, which is about 30 times larger than the first one. This requires significant optimization in network management.

We're proud to keep you updated—don't forget to share your feedback with us!

notes.title: Hotfix v1.03: Gameplay Optimization
notes.content:
Fixed a bug where players would end up in the same room.
Fixed a bug where snap rotation was also activating on the left controller.
Fixed an issue where the crouch button wasn’t working on headsets other than the Oculus.
Added a feature so that when you choose teleport, continuous movement is now disabled.
The teleport system is now available by holding the right joystick up, and you will be teleported upon releasing it.
